core_categories: Pharmaceutical Distribution; Medical-Surgical Supplies; Biologics and Plasma Therapies; Prescription Technology Software; Oncology Solutions; Cell and Gene Therapy Logistics
specialty_focus: McKesson Corporation is a major healthcare services and distribution company managing the supply chain for one-third of all prescription medicines in North America. It specializes in pharmaceutical distribution (branded, generic, specialty, biosimilar, and OTC drugs) and medical-surgical supplies, with a focus on oncology and multispecialty solutions, as well as cell and gene therapy logistics. McKesson serves hospitals, retail chains, independent pharmacies, and alternate-site providers, but does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: McKesson Brand, Health Mart, US Oncology Network, Biologics by McKesson, McKesson Medical-Surgical, McKesson Provider Technologies, Integra Miltex, SS White, 3M, BSN Medical, DeRoyal, Derma Sciences, others
